538:t_1:4.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Martial might is the harmony of all things. Battle itself is peace...」

538:t_1:5.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Devout apostles of $$マーティアル$$! I, your Pope, promise eternity to all of you in the name of God!」

538:t_1:6.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Divine punishment will one day fall on all who oppose our God, beginning with the $$サイデリアル$$...」

538:t_1:7.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Those who will overcome the future of despair... are us!」

538:t_1:8.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
(Come, Untouchable $$キリコ・キュービィー$$. If you defy God's will again, this time I will take your life.)

538:t_1:9.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
(It is not you who receives God's favor! It is me... Pope $$ヴィアチェスラフ・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$!)

538:t_1:10.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
($$キリコ・キュービィー$$... He is one of the greatest mysteries of the $$アストラギウス$$ Galaxy... no, of this entire universe.)

538:t_1:11.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
($$ワイズマン#pilot$$, the god of $$アストラギウス$$... Even a being that reigned over 3,000 years of galactic history could not rule him...)

538:t_1:12.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
(There is no shortage of words for him. The natural-born $$ＰＳ$$, the $$異能生存体$$, the Untouchable...)

538:t_1:13.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
(Each of them is him, and yet it could be said none of them is...)

538:t_1:17.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

538:t_1:18.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「God is in the holy land of $$アレギウム$$...」

538:t_1:19.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「That is what $$キリコ$$ says.」

538:t_1:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「So that is what $$キリコ$$ felt when he touched the $$集合無意識$$.」

538:t_1:22.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「In that case, the appearance of $$マーティアル$$ troops at that scene must be connected somehow, too.」

538:t_1:23.en:
$$マオ$$
「So while $$ダナン$$ throws the Empire into confusion, we go to $$アレギウム$$ and gather information about God.」

538:t_1:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
「A tour of shrines and temples, huh? That's shaping up to be one drab mission.」

538:t_1:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit grumbling. Apparently this god business is somehow tied up with the future of despair.」

538:t_1:26.en:
$n
「It's true we've been fighting people who call themselves gods ever since the $$時獄戦役$$, but...」

538:t_1:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「If we actually try to gather information on that, I have no idea where to even start.」

538:t_1:28.en:
$$アルト$$
「But $$アレギウム$$ is the home base of 《$$マーティアル$$》. If we're gathering information about God, it's probably the best place.」

538:t_1:33.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I belonged to the defense force of the holy land of $$アレギウム$$, but I have never met a being called a god.」

538:t_1:34.en:
$n
「In most cases a god is the concept of an absolute being that people worship, and I don't think it has any actual substance, but...」

538:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
「In the $$霧の海$$, $$ストライカー#pilot$$ tried to become that god.」

538:t_1:36.en:
$n
「In that case it would mean a more direct absolute being, rather than a concept.」

538:t_1:37.en:
$n
「'God' can also mean one who surpasses humans. In other words, a being beyond human who guides people.」

538:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
「Then does that absolute being exist in the place we are headed to now?」

538:t_1:40.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I only said what I felt.」

538:t_1:43.en:
$$カレン$$
「You're more on edge than usual.」

538:t_1:45.en:
$$カレン$$
「We've known each other a long time. And besides...」

538:t_1:46.en:
$n
「That's where $$フィアナ$$ passed away, isn't it...」

538:t_1:48.en:
$n
「I'm sorry. I didn't mean it as blame.」

538:t_1:49.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$テイタニア$$... $$フィアナ$$ died of old age. It wasn't anyone's fault.」

538:t_1:50.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「But as a $$マーティアル$$ soldier, I took away the little time $$キリコ$$ and she had left...」

538:t_1:51.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're making up for that by fighting alongside $$キリコ$$.」

538:t_1:52.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Even so... it is still not enough.」

538:t_1:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Do you have the resolve to risk your life?」

538:t_1:55.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I am always ready for it.」

538:t_1:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「But that does not mean $$キリコ$$ wants you to die.」

538:t_1:58.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Thank you. I feel a little better.」

538:t_1:59.en:
$$宗介$$
「There is no need to thank a comrade.」

538:t_1:64.en:
$$クルツ$$
「They're surprised, that's all. Because you went and comforted somebody.」

538:t_1:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「I cannot tell myself, but it seems so.」

538:t_1:67.en:
$n
「The quiet type hasn't changed much, though.」

538:t_1:68.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're the last person who should say that.」

538:t_1:69.en:
$$アルト$$
(By admitting his feelings for $$かなめ$$, $$宗介$$ has probably become able to understand $$キリコ$$'s fight and the feelings of the people around him.)

538:t_1:70.en:
$$カレン$$
(Compared to the early days of the $$時獄戦役$$, he's changed a lot.)

538:t_1:71.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Still, you folks are fearless. Raiding $$アレギウム$$ of all places.」

538:t_1:72.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah. Even thinking back now, that mission gives me a cold sweat.」

538:t_1:73.en:
$$レド$$
「Is this place called $$アレギウム$$ a strong fortress?」

538:t_1:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「As befits a place called a holy land, there are temples and other buildings standing there. It is not a military facility.」

538:t_1:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What's scary is the people guarding it.」

538:t_1:76.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Never mind their strength, their morale isn't normal.」

538:t_1:78.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Back when I was still a soldier. I tried to sneak in there and got burned badly.」

538:t_1:79.en:
$$レド$$
「Why is their morale so high?」

538:t_1:80.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's the power of faith. They fight under the will of God.」

538:t_1:81.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It gives them absolute confidence in what they do and wipes out any hesitation or doubt, see.」

538:t_1:82.en:
$$マオ$$
「With people like that, no wonder they can fight the Empire separately from the $$地球連邦軍$$.」

538:t_1:83.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even the $$サイデリアル$$ will have a hard time making them give up.」

538:t_1:84.en:
$$宗介$$
「Thanks to that, the authority they lost in the 《$$赫い霍乱$$》 has apparently recovered to a fair degree.」

538:t_1:85.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Those are the guys we're up against. If it comes to a fight with $$マーティアル$$ at $$アレギウム$$, it'll turn into a mess.」
